post.title: Gloomy all summer, Amex cardholders spent $454B anyway
post.ig:
Americans felt gloomy all summer. Amex cardholders spent $454 billion anyway.
The University of Michigan's final October consumer sentiment index came in at 48.0, which Reuters calls the second-lowest on record (May 2026: 44.8).
People expect prices to rise 4.7% over the next year.
American Express card member spending hit $454 billion in Q3 2026, up 8% from $421 billion, led by affluent customers per Reuters.
Sources: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, American Express Q3 2026 release, Reuters, Oct 23, 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
